documents.name: Licence Agreement - Marsh & Teague.txt
documents.text:
LICENCE AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is made between Quillon Software Ltd (the "Licensor") and Marsh & Teague LLP (the "Licensee").

1. Term
1.1 This Agreement continues for an initial term of three (3) years from 1 July 2024 (the "Initial Term").
1.2 It renews for successive one-year terms unless either party gives notice at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term.

2. Licence
2.1 The Licensee may not assign or sublicense this Agreement without the Licensor's prior written consent.

3. Termination
3.1 The Licensor may terminate this Agreement immediately if the Licensee is subject to a change of control.
3.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach on thirty (30) days' written notice.

4. Liability
4.1 Neither party limits its liability for breach of clause 6 (Confidentiality), and that liability is unlimited.

5. Law
5.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California.
